selection_rules.stock: Choose 01a or 01b for the lower LM piece; 02–04 are shared. Then choose exactly one attachment set: A shoulders or B1 wings.
selection_rules.slim: Choose 01a or 01b for the lower LM piece; 02–04 are shared. Then choose exactly one attachment set: A shoulders or B1 wings.
selection_rules.obiwan: Choose either the individual core files (01a or 01b, plus 02–04) or the no-floor 01a+02+03+04 single-plate alternative; never print both forms. Then choose Ac or Ae and exactly one wing split: a (3 pieces per side) or b (2 pieces per side).
